newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul shares end down at 3-year closing low.
newsitem.headline: Seoul shares end down at 3-year closing low.

text.p: Stocks fell slightly to a three-year closing low on Saturday as selling late in the session outweighed an early technical rebound, brokers said.
The composite stock index ended 1.73 points, or 0.25 percent lower at 687.34, the lowest close since September 18, 1993, when the index was 685.94.
The previous record low for the same three-year period was 689.07 set on Friday.
